evidence.eventual_fix_title: Annotations: Fix keyboard a11y in Annotation list
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement: Annotations: Fix keyboard a11y in Annotation list **What this PR does / why we need it**: Currently the annotation name is not focusable so a keyboard user could not update an annotation: This PR fixes that using a button to wrap the annotation name: | Before | After | Variables tab (for comparison) | | ------ | ------ | ------ | | | | | **Which issue(s) this PR fixes**: Fixes #56564 **Special notes for your reviewer**: 1. I have no idea who the code owners are, feel free to assign other reviewers 😃 2. For consistency with the template variable list (much more needed in the matter - delete button / reorder is different) I removed the comment icon. I don't mind adding it back if reviewers would rather we keep it. If so here are a few options we can use for focus: | 1. icon + text | | | ------ | ------ | | 2. icon only | | | 3. text only | |
